Seven milestones besides project completion moved in this update. Five finish later and two finish earlier. The biggest move is #MS-P07 (Phase 7 complete), which slipped +65 working days. That is the same slip as #MS-COMPLETE, and both now finish on 2029-06-22, so Phase 7 looks like the phase setting the completion date.

| Milestone | Name | Previous finish | Current finish | Slip (working days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| #MS-P07 | Phase 7 complete | 2029-03-23 | 2029-06-22 | +65 |
| #MS-P03 | Phase 3 complete | 2028-05-17 | 2028-05-24 | +5 |
| #MS-P05 | Phase 5 complete | 2028-12-15 | 2028-12-22 | +5 |
| #MS-P04 | Phase 4 complete | 2028-09-12 | 2028-09-18 | +4 |
| #MS-P06 | Phase 6 complete | 2029-03-09 | 2029-03-12 | +1 |
| #MS-P01 | Phase 1 complete | 2027-11-11 | 2027-11-04 | -5 |
| #MS-P02 | Phase 2 complete | 2028-03-23 | 2028-02-18 | -24 |

Phases 3 to 6 slipped by between 1 and 5 days. That suggests the +65 days on Phase 7 comes mostly from within Phase 7, not from delay passed down from earlier phases. I haven't traced it yet, though, so that's only an inference. Phases 1 and 2 have both come forward, Phase 2 by nearly five weeks.

I can trace what is driving #MS-P07, or the Phase 2 gain, if you'd like to see which activities caused the movement.
